# northflank_secret_group (Resource)

Manages a secret group in a Northflank project. A secret group holds environment variables and build arguments that services and jobs in the project inherit, optionally restricted to specific resources, tags or environments.

Variable values are stored in Terraform state. Treat the state file as a secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "northflank_project" "app" {
  name   = "My Application"
  region = "europe-west"
}

# Available to every service and job in the project.
resource "northflank_secret_group" "shared" {
  project_id  = northflank_project.app.id
  name        = "Shared Config"
  description = "Settings every service reads."
  type        = "config"

  variables = {
    LOG_LEVEL = "info"
    NODE_ENV  = "production"
  }
}

# Runtime-only secrets, restricted to one service, and merged over the shared
# group thanks to the higher priority.
resource "northflank_secret_group" "api" {
  project_id  = northflank_project.app.id
  name        = "API Secrets"
  priority    = 20
  secret_type = "environment"

  variables = {
    DATABASE_URL = var.database_url
  }

  restrictions = {
    restricted = true
    resources = [
      { id = "api", type = "service" },
    ]
  }
}

# Read in the Dockerfile with RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc.
resource "northflank_secret_group" "build" {
  project_id  = northflank_project.app.id
  name        = "Build Secrets"
  secret_type = "arguments"

  docker_secret_mounts = {
    npmrc = var.npmrc
  }

  restrictions = {
    restricted = true
    resources = [
      { id = "api-builder", type = "service" },
    ]
  }
}

variable "npmrc" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "database_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the secret group, 3 to 100 characters. Changing this forces a new secret group, since Northflank derives the `id` from it and cannot rename one.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the secret group belongs to. Changing this forces a new secret group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Short description of the secret group, up to 200 characters. Removing it from configuration keeps the current value, since the API cannot clear it.
- `docker_secret_mounts` (Map of String, Sensitive) Docker secret mounts for builds, as a map of mount ID to content, read in a Dockerfile with `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=<mount ID>`. Values are encrypted at rest by Northflank, but also stored in Terraform state. Northflank never reports mounts back, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected, and an imported secret group has none until they are configured. Leave out to keep mounts managed elsewhere; removing the attribute deletes the mounts it set.
- `priority` (Number) Priority, from 0 to 100, used to merge secret groups that define the same key: the higher priority wins. Defaults to `10`.
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Limits which resources inherit the secret group. Leave out to make it available to every service and job in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `secret_type` (String) Where the variables are injected: `environment-arguments` for both runtime environment variables and build arguments, `environment` for runtime only, or `arguments` for build arguments only. Defaults to `environment-arguments`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Previously defined Northflank tags to attach to the secret group.
- `type` (String) Permission type of the group: `secret`, whose values need secret-level permissions to view, or `config`. Defaults to `secret`.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret variables, as a map of name to value. Values are encrypted at rest by Northflank, but also stored in Terraform state.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the secret group, derived by Northflank from `name`.
- `updated_at` (String) Time of the last update, in RFC 3339 format.

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Required:

- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether the restrictions apply. When `true`, only the resources, tagged resources and environments listed here inherit the group.

Optional:

- `resources` (Attributes Set) Services and jobs the secret group is restricted to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions--resources))
- `stage_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the environments the secret group is restricted to.
- `tag_match_condition` (String) Whether a resource needs `and` all of `tags`, or `or` any one of them.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags a resource must carry to inherit the secret group.

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions.resources`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the service or job.
- `type` (String) Kind of resource: `service` or `job`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Secret groups are imported as <project_id>/<secret_group_id>.
terraform import northflank_secret_group.api my-application/api-secrets
```
